item.title: Paper accepted at NeurIPS 2026
item.description: A CILab paper has been accepted at NeurIPS 2026.

item.title: CILab at ICPR 2026: PRESTIGE and IAPR Distinction Award
item.description: CILab took part in ICPR 2026 with research presentations, session chairing and the first PRESTIGE workshop; Gennaro Vessio also received an IAPR Distinction Award.

item.title: VISTA: drone and AI for roadside rescue
item.description: The first demonstration video presents CILab research on drone-based visual assistance and AI for post-crash emergency response.

item.title: CILab at Ital-IA 2026
item.description: CILab presented work on sustainable few-shot segmentation, real-time drone vision for road safety, and reliable large language models.

item.title: FAPER and ADV workshops at ICIAP 2025
item.description: CILab organized the fourth edition of FAPER and the first edition of ADV at ICIAP 2025.

item.title: Outstanding Paper Award at IFSA-NAFIPS 2025
item.description: CILab received the Outstanding Paper Award at IFSA-NAFIPS 2025.

item.title: IEEE CIS Italy Best Conference Paper Honorable Mention
item.description: A CILab contribution received the IEEE CIS Italy Chapter Best Conference Paper Honorable Mention at IJCNN 2025.

item.title: Best Paper Award at NL4AI 2024

item.title: Best Paper Distinction Award at FedCSIS 2023
